verdict.rationale: Trivy's core is a deterministic scanner with no built-in AI. AI-driven insight comes only through the official trivy-mcp plugin, which exposes Trivy's scanning to VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools so users can 'ask questions about security issues in natural language.' The insights are produced by an external AI client rather than inside Trivy itself. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions (e.g., AI remediation advice or summaries in the CLI or report output), detailed docs on what the natural-language scanning returns, and hands-on or independent corroboration that it works.
